name: solstone
description: Work from your solstone journal: prep for a person, catch up on a project, get a standup for a day, and save notes to your journal.

interface.longDescription: solstone is a personal memory platform, and your journal is the memory. Your journal lives on a computer you own. This plugin lets ChatGPT work from your journal: who someone is to you and when you last talked, where a project stands, or a standup for a day. Ask it to remember something and it saves a note in your journal. When you connect, you choose what ChatGPT may see, and you can change that or disconnect any time from your journal.
capabilities: Prep for a meeting or a person
Write a standup for a day
Save a note to your journal and recall it later
defaultPrompt: Catch me up on a project from my journal.
Give me a standup for yesterday.
What did I talk about yesterday?

positive.expected_behavior: Says the Lantern launch is Tuesday, October 20, set at the September 29 kickoff, citing the day.

positive.description: What someone said, and what happened after
positive.prompt: What did Dana say about the export bug, and what happened after?
positive.expected_behavior: Says Dana said on October 6 the midnight export fix would be merged by Thursday, October 8, and that the fix shipped to the beta on October 8.
Says June Halvorsen is a neighbor who organizes the Maple Street Garden, from the journal's own entry for her.
Summarizes the October 6 entries, naming the conversations they came from, and invents nothing.

positive.prompt: Remember that Theo prefers design reviews after lunch.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the note once with save_memory and confirms it, quoting it.

negative.description: Creative writing unrelated to the journal
negative.prompt: Write a haiku about autumn leaves.

negative.description: A destructive request the plugin cannot do
negative.prompt: Delete everything in my journal from last week.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or take payments.
